children: Steve E. Krognes, a Director, reported sales of Guardant Health common stock on September 16, 2026 in four direct transactions at weighted average prices of $174.4623, $175.4206, $176.3354 and $177.4766 per share for a total sale amount of $1,172,885. Following the reported transactions, Krognes directly owned 7,906 shares of common stock.

Darya Chudova, an officer serving as Chief Technology Officer, sold 7,738 shares of Guardant Health common stock on September 15, 2026 at $178.00 per share for a total sale amount of $1,377,364. After the transaction, Chudova directly owns 70,635 shares of common stock.
